Let \(r\) be the radius of circle \(k\), and let \(U\) be the area of \(k_2\) that lies inside \(k\) but outside \(k_1\).

The shaded area inside \(k\) but outside \(k_1\) is
\[
\pi r^2 - 64\pi - U.
\]
The total shaded area inside \(k_2\) is
\[
225\pi - U.
\]
Equating these:
\[
\pi r^2 - 64\pi - U = 225\pi - U
\]
\[
\pi r^2 - 64\pi = 225\pi
\]
\[
r^2 = 289
\]
\[
r = 17.
\]

\boxed{17\text{ cm}}
